whenToUse: Support service-level monitoring: breaches, due-next clocks and a live breach-watch list.
Team leads who bulk assign, escalate and send first replies with macros.
avoidWhen: Working one ticket end to end — use detail-09.
A plain countdown on a record — use sla-timer.
a11y: Live counts use aria-live regions; the deadline horizon is role="img" with a label.
Queue filters are aria-pressed toggles; avoid announcing every timer tick to assistive tech.
